units.source_text: 自此以后，薰中纳言总想摒除邪念，光明正大地照顾二女公子。

en.t: From then on, Kaoru Chūnagon kept trying to cast aside improper thoughts and care for the Second Princess openly and honorably.

units.source_text: 然而力不从心，恋慕之情非常痛苦。

en.t: Yet his heart would not obey him, and the longing of love was terribly painful.

units.source_text: 因此写给二女公子的信，比以前详细了，动辄透露难于忍受的恋情。

en.t: As a result, the letters he wrote to the Second Princess became more detailed than before, and at every turn they revealed a love too hard to endure.

units.source_text: 二女公子看了，自恨罪孽缠身，悲叹不已。

en.t: When the Second Princess read them, she blamed herself for being bound by sinful karma and grieved without end.

units.source_text: 她想：“倘是素不相识之人，可以骂他一声‘何其痴狂！’

en.t: She thought, "If he were someone I had never known, I could scold him by saying, 'How madly foolish you are!'
It would also be very easy to reject him.

units.source_text: 可是此人不同，自昔早有交往，互相信赖。

en.t: But this man is different; we have long been acquainted and have trusted each other since earlier days.

units.source_text: 如果今天忽然和他决绝，反而引起别人疑怪。

en.t: If I were suddenly to break with him now, it would instead arouse other people's suspicion.

units.source_text: 他那竭诚尽忠的心情与态度，我并非不知感激。

en.t: It is not that I fail to appreciate the sincerity and devotion shown in his feelings and conduct.

units.source_text: 但倘要我为此而开诚解怀地对待他，我实在颇多顾虑。

en.t: But if I am expected for that reason to open my heart and treat him frankly, I truly have many misgivings.
What, in the end, should I do?"
She turned the matter over and over in her mind, her thoughts in complete disorder.

units.source_text: 她身边的侍女之中，稍明事理而可与共话的青年人，都是新进来的，未便和她们深谈。

en.t: Among the women attending her, the younger ones who understood matters a little and could be spoken with were all newcomers, so it was not convenient to confide deeply in them.

units.source_text: 一向熟悉的人，只是从宇治山乡带来的几个老侍女，同她们也没商量。

en.t: The only people she had long known were a few elderly attendants brought from the mountain village of Uji, and she could not consult with them either.

units.source_text: 志同道合而可与罄谈心事的人，简直没有。

en.t: There was simply no one of like mind with whom she could fully speak her heart.

units.source_text: 因此无时不怀念已故的姐姐。

en.t: For that reason, there was never a time when she did not miss her late elder sister.

units.source_text: 她想：“如果姐姐在世，此人不会对我发生这种不良之心吧。”

en.t: She thought, "If my sister were still alive, this man would never have formed such improper feelings toward me."
Her heart was overwhelmed with unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的薄幸固已可悲，但薰中纳言之事使她更觉痛苦。

en.t: Niou Prince's fickleness was already sorrowful enough, but the matter of Kaoru Chūnagon made her feel still greater pain.
